description: This file implements the map_labels class for managing labels on a game map, including reading, writing, setting, clearing, scrolling, and recalculating labels, as well as handling shroud visibility.

classes.name: map_labels
classes.description: Class for managing labels on a game map, including their creation, removal, and visibility based on shroud status.

methods.name: map_labels
methods.description: Constructor initializing map_labels with display and map references.

methods.name: map_labels
methods.description: Constructor initializing map_labels with display, config, and map references, and reading configuration.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Serializes labels into a config object.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads label data from a config object.

methods.name: get_label
methods.description: Returns the label text for a given index or location.

methods.name: set_label
methods.description: Sets a label at a specific location with given text, handling label creation and shroud visibility.

methods.name: scroll
methods.description: Moves all labels by specified x and y offsets.

methods.name: recalculate_labels
methods.description: Recreates all labels based on current data.

methods.name: recalculate_shroud
methods.description: Updates label visibility based on shroud status.
